findings.evidence: The diff edits the 'Execution-time freshness check' paragraph in docs/engineering/model-routing.md to say 'omitting `--tier`', but leaves the next sentence unchanged: 'Passing `--profile` explicitly still works exactly as before (useful for a legacy package with no receipt, or for a deliberate override)'. The new `_RemovedProfile` action in scripts/dogfood_task.py raises a parser error for `--profile`. The spec requires 'Source docs and hints SHALL name only R1/R2/R3 for these commands'. The same section still describes `routine`/`standard`/`complex` as the profiles of `route-codex`.
findings.summary: docs/engineering/model-routing.md still says that passing `--profile` explicitly works as before. The change makes `dogfood_task.py route-*` refuse `--profile`.

findings.evidence: The diff changes the RoutingError in model_routing.py `prepare` to 'pass an explicit --profile (dogfood_task.py route-*: --tier R1|R2|R3)'.
